data.exact_reserve_text: Net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023, a common trend seen across the market.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Inwards RITC executed transferring 2017-2019 liabilities; premium of GBP 75,243k received and liabilities of equivalent value transferred into the Syndicate.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 55.574m at 1 Jan 2023 and the Syndicate reports that net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023. Management carried out a line-by-line review and applied an explicit GBP 2.2m uplift for inflation. A 2022 inwards RITC (Syndicate 2689, 2017-2019) also transferred significant legacy liabilities into the Syndicate in 2022.
raw_causal_phrases: Net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023, a common trend seen across the market.
A detailed review by line of business has been performed, resulting in an explicit uplift to claims reserves of GBP 2.2m.
While the Syndicate has seen some direct evidence of claims inflation, there are delays before current levels of inflation affect future claims payments.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year-only reserve movement figure was found in the disclosed notes. The report states that "Net prior year reserves ... were strengthened" but gives no gross PYD amount. A 2022 inwards RITC (Syndicate 2689, 2017-2019) materially changed reserve composition and may distort development tables. A claims development triangle exists in the notes but could not be reliably parsed to calculate gross PYD from diagonals; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null and direction inferred from narrative.
